Under the note's claim (Cara in slot 4, Ann in slot 6), Hana is in slot 5. Ivo, Finn and Gus are consecutive and all after Cara, so they must take slots 7, 8 and 9. Elif must come after Ann, so Elif would need slot 7 or later, but those slots are already taken. The note's claim is therefore impossible.

- **Elif and Hana:** slots 9 and 3, 6 apart.

I only worked through the case where Cara is in slot 2. I haven't shown this is the only valid schedule.
